caveats.statement: Power can be '*' or NULL for unknown/infinite power cards, so equality checks miss NULLs.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*' OR power IS NULL;

caveats.statement: isStorySpotlight is often misspelled as isStorylight in evidence; the actual column is isStorySpotlight.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1;

caveats.statement: Foreign translations may exist for a card but the language column values differ in casing/spelling (e.g. 'Chinese Simplified').
A card may have multiple legality rows (one per format), so joining without filtering format inflates counts.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) FROM legalities GROUP BY uuid HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: Rulings are keyed by uuid; counting rulings per card requires grouping by uuid, not by ruling id.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS c FROM rulings GROUP BY uuid ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: cardKingdomFoilId and cardKingdomId must both be non-null to indicate a 'powerful foil'; checking only one gives wrong results.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NULL;

caveats.statement: Set translations are keyed by setCode, not by set name; joining on name will fail.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT s.name, st.translation FROM sets s JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode WHERE st.language = 'Chinese Simplified' LIMIT 5;

evidence.result: [["Tenth Edition", "核心系列第十版"], ["Fourth Edition", null], ["Fifth Dawn", "五色曙光"]]

caveats.statement: isForeignOnly applies to sets, not cards; using it on cards table returns nothing.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sets WHERE isForeignOnly = 1;

caveats.statement: Some cards have NULL colors (colorless), so filtering colors = 'B' excludes them intentionally but may surprise.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE colors IS NULL;
